Fields.Name: Rider Model ID
Fields.Description: Model number of the rider (cXXXX, e.g. 3000 for c3000; 0 is the player). Must match the rider's model for this row to be used.

Fields.Name: Mount Model ID
Fields.Description: It is a parameter that identifies the character of the riding side when riding.

Fields.Name: Ride - Camera Param ID
Fields.Description: It is a parameter to change the camera parameter at the time of riding to a dedicated camera. It is a parameter for PC only, and it does not work even if it is set to the enemy.

Fields.Name: Rider - Ride-On Animation Variant
Fields.Description: Value given to the rider's ride-on animation when mounting with this row; selects which mount animation plays.

Fields.Name: Mount - Ridden Animation Variant
Fields.Description: Value given to the mount's ridden animation when mounted with this row.

Fields.Name: Mount - Adjust Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly on the mount that the rider is attached to (the rider side always uses its dummy poly 500).

Fields.Name: Mount - Check Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly on the mount that the distance and angle checks are measured to. -1 or a missing dummy poly: the mount's own position.

Fields.Name: Rider Facing Angle Limit
Fields.Description: Maximum angle (degrees) between the rider's facing and the direction to the mount. 180: any facing.

Fields.Name: Mount Distance
Fields.Description: The rider must be closer than this distance (m, straight-line) to the mount.

Fields.Name: Mount Distance - Max Height Above
Fields.Description: How far (m) the mount may be above the rider.

Fields.Name: Mount Distance - Max Height Below
Fields.Description: How far (m) the mount may be below the rider.

Fields.Name: Approach Angle - Min
Fields.Description: Start of the allowed approach window: the rider's position around the mount, in degrees from the mount's front (0 front, ±180 behind; one side negative, the other positive). If Min is greater than Max, the window wraps through 180 (e.g. 150 to -150 is behind the mount). -180 to 180: any side.

Fields.Name: Approach Angle - Max
Fields.Description: End of the allowed approach window, in degrees from the mount's front (see Approach Angle - Min).
